pull.title: jobs: add private worker service areas
pull.body:
## Summary
- add an owner-only private service-area preference with a PostGIS center point and 1–100 km radius
- expose authenticated `GET/PUT/DELETE /users/me/service-area`
- add Flyway V34 with one service area per user, database radius constraints, cascade ownership and a GIST geography index
- keep exact center coordinates out of public profiles, jobs, trust cards, URLs, notifications and other users' responses
- narrow `GET /jobs/recommended` with `ST_DWithin` when an area is configured while preserving specialization-only recommendations as the fallback
- keep own-job and bilateral block exclusion in the database before pagination
- expose only `serviceAreaRadiusKm` in recommendation metadata, never the private center
- add a profile map/radius editor with create/update/disable controls and explicit privacy messaging
- add backend regression tests and focused privacy/architecture documentation

## Matching semantics
The service area describes where a worker is willing to **start** work. For point-to-point jobs, recommendation matching uses the job origin; the destination does not have to stay inside the radius. This keeps the model useful for errands and courier jobs rather than turning the radius into a route geofence.

## Privacy
- owner coordinates are readable only from `/users/me/service-area` so the settings UI can restore the marker
- public `UserPublicProfileResponse` remains unchanged
- recommendations still return the normal privacy-safe `JobResponse`
- configuring an area grants no exact job-location, route or live-tracking access
- free-form public location such as `Wrocław i okolice` remains independent from the private PostGIS point

## Validation
- finite latitude/longitude plus normal range validation
- 1–100 km enforced in API validation and again by the database constraint
- tests verify JTS `X=longitude`, `Y=latitude`, delete scoping, fallback recommendation behavior and spatial query routing
- merge only after Maven verify, frontend audit/lint/build, Flyway/PostGIS runtime smoke and all selected repository checks are green
